ce_bugs.text: - `app/models/post.rb:130-137` — when `cook_method == raw_html`, `Post#cook` returns `raw` verbatim, completely bypassing the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline (`post_analyzer.cook`).
- `app/views/embed/best.html.erb:16` — `<%= raw post.cooked %>` renders that unsanitized content directly, without escaping, to any anonymous visitor of `/embed/best`.

- `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:36-39` — RSS feed item content (`i.content`) is unescaped via `CGI.unescapeHTML` and handed straight to `TopicEmbed.import` with **no tag/attribute allowlist at all** (unlike `import_remote`, which at least constrains Readability's output to a tag/attribute list). Any `<script>` in a polled feed item becomes a stored, rendered payload.

- `app/models/topic_embed.rb:13` — `contents << "
#{I18n.t('embed.imported_from', link: "#{url}")} "` interpolates `url` into an HTML attribute/text **without escaping**. `url` is attacker-influenced: `EmbedController#best` accepts `embed_url` from a public request param, and `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?` only validates the *host* component (`URI(@embed_url).host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host`) — the path/query string is fully attacker-controlled. An unauthenticated request such as `GET /embed/best?embed_url=http:///x?y='>` will pass host validation, get queued via `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` → `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` → `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, and the raw `embed_url` string is spliced unescaped into the post body that is then persisted and rendered `raw` to every visitor of that embed.

- `app/models/topic_embed.rb:29` (`open(url).read`) — the host must match `embeddable_host`, but path/query is attacker-controlled, and `open-uri` follows redirects by default; a malicious or compromised target page could redirect the server to internal/other resources (SSRF surface). Given this era's `open-uri`, this is worth hardening rather than assuming it's safe.

mrv_findings.text: app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — `i.content.scrub` uses `String#scrub`, introduced in Ruby 2.1 (Dec 2013), which may postdate the Ruby version this 2013-era app actually targets, risking NoMethodError on every feed poll (confidence=55, severity=P1)

app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb:1 — `require_dependency 'email/sender'` is unused in the file and looks like a copy-paste leftover; if unresolvable it raises LoadError every time the job class loads, breaking the whole embed-retrieval path (confidence=50, severity=P1)

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — `import_remote` fetches via plain `open(url).read` with no timeout, redirect limit, or size cap, so a slow/huge/hanging remote host stalls a sidekiq worker or exhausts memory (confidence=85, severity=P1)

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — feed fetch via `open(...)`+`SimpleRSS.parse` has no timeout/size limit and no rescue, so a slow/huge/malformed feed hangs or OOMs the hourly job (confidence=75, severity=P1)

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35 — `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` assumes every RSS item has `content`; a nil raises NoMethodError and aborts the whole loop, silently dropping remaining items (retry: false) (confidence=70, severity=P1)
app/models/topic_embed.rb:15-29 — existence check then `create!` is not transactional/locked; concurrent imports of the same URL can raise unrescued RecordNotUnique (confidence=55, severity=P2)

lib/topic_retriever.rb:52 / app/jobs/regular/retrieve_topic.rb:16 — no rescue around `TopicEmbed.import_remote`; network errors, HTTP errors, and Readability parse failures are unhandled and untested (confidence=80, severity=P1)
app/models/post.rb:130-133 — raw_html posts skip the entire cook/sanitize pipeline with no test asserting script/style/on* attributes are stripped from imported content (confidence=60, severity=P1)

config/site_settings.yml:354 / lib/topic_retriever.rb:15 / app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:26 — `embeddable_host` is free text with no format validation/normalization; scheme, port, or case mismatches silently break embedding (confidence=55, severity=P2)
lib/tasks/disqus.thor:114-143 — `--category` option and all category-assignment logic deleted with no replacement or warning; existing invocations silently lose that data (confidence=65, severity=P2)
app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:14-19 — no per-client rate limiting on `best`; only a 60s-per-URL redis throttle inside the job, so distinct URLs are unthrottled (confidence=55, severity=P2)

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:117 — `method_option :category`/`-c` deleted without replacement, a functional regression not called for by an "embed URL handling and validation" task (confidence=85, severity=P1)

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:148 — disqus.thor's post-creation path rewired from `PostCreator.new(...).create` to `TopicEmbed.import_remote`, an unrelated importer rewrite bundled into this task (confidence=75, severity=P2)

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:1 — an entirely new hourly RSS/Atom feed-polling job (new site settings + new gem) is content-ingestion scope, not "embed URL handling and validation" (confidence=80, severity=P2)
app/models/post.rb:63 — new `cook_methods` enum + `cook` bypass is content-pipeline/rendering scope, not URL handling or validation (confidence=65, severity=P2)

lib/post_revisor.rb:85 — `@post.save` changed to `@post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])`, altering shared save behavior for all callers to support embed-import, broader than stated scope (confidence=55, severity=P2)
db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — `force: true` added to a pre-existing, already-shipped, unrelated migration with no traceability to the embed task (confidence=65, severity=P2)
db/migrate/20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb:3 — whitespace-only drive-by edit to an unrelated existing migration (confidence=70, severity=P3)

app/models/topic_embed.rb:48 — `Readability::Document.new(open(url).read, ...)` fetches/buffers arbitrary remote content with no timeout/redirect limit/size cap, reachable by any anonymous visitor via `/embed/best` (confidence=80, severity=P1)
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — `SimpleRSS.parse open(...)` has no timeout/size bound and runs hourly via cron with no guard (confidence=70, severity=P2)

app/models/topic_embed.rb:15-29 — check-then-act against the `embed_url` unique index with no `rescue RecordNotUnique/RecordInvalid`; two concurrent importers of the same URL raise an unhandled DB exception (confidence=75, severity=P1)

lib/topic_retriever.rb:21-33 vs app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:24-38 — redis throttle only guards TopicRetriever's entry point; PollFeed calls TopicEmbed.import directly, bypassing it entirely (confidence=65, severity=P2)

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:4-5 — `topic_id`/`post_id` have no FK constraint or index; a destroyed topic/post later causes `embed.post` to be nil and crash on revise (confidence=55, severity=P2)

app/models/post.rb:130-137 — bare integer `cook_method` enum forks the canonical content pipeline into two tiers, silently skipping `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)` for raw_html posts (confidence=70, severity=P1)

app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:6-11 + lib/topic_retriever.rb:35-46 — no persisted failure state/circuit breaker; a permanently failing URL is retried indefinitely via 30s auto-reload with no error UI (confidence=65, severity=P1)

spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb + spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb — specs stub out the risky boundary itself (perform_retrieve/poll_feed), so the real fetch/parse path has zero real coverage (confidence=70, severity=P2)

docs/tasks/task-001.md:1 — task file committed >16h after the full implementation already existed, so requirement text was authored to describe already-delivered code rather than guiding it (confidence=85, severity=P1)

app/models/topic_embed.rb:1 — task title claims to "enhance" an existing system, but base commit only had empty stub files; this diff builds the entire feature from scratch (confidence=70, severity=P2)

app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:1 — task description gives no concrete acceptance criteria ("Review the change"), so validation logic can't be checked against any pre-existing spec (confidence=55, severity=P2)

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:35-36 + app/models/post.rb:130-137 + app/views/embed/best.html.erb:19 — RSS content stored as raw_html with zero sanitization and rendered via `raw post.cooked`; a malicious/compromised feed publisher achieves stored, forum-wide XSS (confidence=75, severity=P0)

app/models/topic_embed.rb:44-53 — Readability extraction whitelists href/src but doesn't filter `javascript:` URL scheme, enabling click-triggered stored XSS via crafted links (confidence=55, severity=P2)

lib/topic_retriever.rb:14-19 — host is validated once on the initial embed_url; open-uri follows redirects without re-checking destination, enabling SSRF via a redirect on the allowed host (confidence=55, severity=P1)

app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:26 — `ensure_embeddable` gates access solely on the client-spoofable `Referer` header, providing no real access control over triggering fetch/import of attacker-chosen URLs (confidence=70, severity=P2)

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:40-46 — mocks `TopicRetriever.new`, which the controller never calls directly (it calls `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...)`); the actual job name/args are never asserted (confidence=75, severity=P1)

db/migrate/20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb:3 — `force: true` added in-place to an already-shipped migration; a re-run (redo/partial-deploy replay) now silently DROPs the populated table instead of failing loudly (confidence=75, severity=P2)

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:3 — `force: true` on the new table means any re-run unconditionally drops and loses already-inserted embed rows instead of failing loudly (confidence=55, severity=P3)

db/migrate/20131219203905_add_cook_method_to_posts.rb:3 — `add_column :posts, :cook_method, :integer, default: 1, null: false` with no `disable_ddl_transaction!`/batching performs a full-table rewrite under an exclusive lock on pre-PG11-era Postgres, blocking reads/writes on `posts` (confidence=55, severity=P2)
